title: K01 — You're not weak

lines.vo: You're not weak. You're just tired of losing.
lines.txt: You're not _weak._ You're just tired of *losing.*

lines.vo: It's two A.M. You promised yourself. Again.
One night. A week of guilt.
But here's what nobody tells you.
You don't need more motivation. You need proof.
lines.txt: You don't need motivation. You need *proof.*

lines.vo: Clean day, plus one. Slip, minus five.
One slip can't erase thirty days.
Comment link, and I'll send you the app.
lines.txt: Comment *LINK* and I'll send you the app.

caption:
You're not weak. You're tired of losing to yourself. 🖤
